newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes flat, loses early edge.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes flat, loses early edge.

text.p: Tight selling of the U.S. currency by state-owned banks forced the Bangladesh taka to lose its early edge in interbank trading on Tuesday, dealers said.
The taka finished at Monday's closing level of 44.2100/2200 to the dollar.
Early deals were done at 44.2000 per dollar but the local unit slipped later amid tight dollar selling by major state-owned banks.
The call money was traded at 8.0 to 9.0 percent, slightly up from the previous 7.75-8.25 percent.
